_comment: Known-reviewed exemptions for the 'static-scan-skills' CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml) and for
scripts/ci-scan-skills.test.js, which runs the same check in the required 'Test suites' job.
Both run scripts/ci-scan-skills.js, which runs skills/skill-audit/scripts/static-scan.js — the SAME
scanner skill-audit uses to vet EXTERNALLY SOURCED skills before install — in two passes:
- general:     every skill in skills/*/; keeps every BLOCK finding, plus the conformance checks
- conformance: .claude/agents/*.md, packs/*/skills/, packs/*/tools/, infra/hermes-agent/skills/;
keeps ONLY the conformance checks
The conformance checks (P0-02) are unpinned-install, curl-pipe-shell and wget-pipe-shell, kept at
any severity: the scanner rates a command found only in markdown code a FLAG, and in this repo's
own definitions a code block is the instruction Claude runs.
Each entry names its pass ('general' or 'conformance'), its repo-relative path (forward slashes)
and its check, plus the reason and the human review. Each pass diffs and checks staleness only
against its own entries, so a general entry never covers or goes stale for a conformance finding,
and the reverse. An entry without a known pass, a repo-relative path and a check fails the run.
The three entries below are general-pass BLOCK findings on the 'child-process-require' check, all
in *.test.js harness files (never a production script) that invoke `node <script-under-test>`
via execSync/spawnSync to exercise a CLI script end-to-end. That is ordinary test-harness
usage, not a payload. static-scan.js itself is NOT modified and NOT weakened by this file —
it still returns BLOCK for these three files when run directly (skill-audit's vetting of
external skills is completely unaffected). This baseline only narrows what CI treats as a
build failure, for these three specific, reviewed files. On 2026-10-23 (P0-02) their key moved
from skill + skill-relative file to pass + repo-relative path; their review is unchanged.
scripts/ci-scan-skills.js diffs the scanner's live findings against this list every run:
- any finding NOT listed here for its pass       -> CI FAILS (a genuinely new finding)
- any entry listed here that no longer fires    -> CI FAILS as a STALE BASELINE
(prune the stale entry — a suppression nobody reviews any more is how a baseline
rots into a blanket exemption)
Adding a new entry requires human review — do not add one to silence a finding you have
not personally read and understood. Reviewed by: erick.sicard@dentaledgesolutions.com,
2026-08-24, as part of restoring the CI gate to green (see feat/hermes-governed-syscall).
